title: Sign Twisting Preserves Relative Distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $\mathrm{phase},f,g:\Omega\to\{\pm1\}$. Multiplying both $f$ and $g$ pointwise by the same phase function preserves their relative Hamming distance.
